name: Schwyz
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Schwyz
summary: A red square with a small white cross in the upper hoist. Schwyz gave both its name and its flag to Switzerland.
origin: Schwyz used a plain red banner in the Middle Ages; the small white cross was added later. Its red banner and the white cross of confederate soldiers led to the Swiss national flag.

symbols.name: White cross
symbols.description: A small cross in the upper hoist.
symbols.meaning: Christianity; precursor of the Swiss cross.

facts: The national flag of Switzerland developed from Schwyz's banner.
clues: A red square with a small white cross in the corner.
It gave its name to an entire country.
A founding canton whose banner became a national flag.
